DDoS_allowed: new fully eligible F-ADAPTATION ground-truth DDoS only
PortScan_allowed: validated Experiment E runtime PortScan adaptation evidence
optional new F-ADAPTATION PortScan only if preregistered

eligibility_all: approved F2 profile and bounded limits recorded before execution
four independent generator VM identities each verified
controlled target ownership and source-to-target route verified
synchronized named session window with observer visibility on enp0s3
source/destination tuple and timestamps match PCAP, generator logs, and workload manifest
PCAP and raw 84-column CSV hashes, extractor/adapter provenance, session ID and lineage ID recorded
request/connection counts and generator-level evidence retained; target-side logs retained when available
invalidators: model prediction used as label source
missing/contradictory source identity, hashes, window, logs, or provenance
out-of-scope endpoint, uncontrolled target, routing/observer failure
ddos_labeling.label: DDoS
ddos_labeling.rule: All eligibility conditions are required; no silent imputation, inferred label, or partial-evidence relabeling.

deviations.ABORTED: Safety, routing, target, or generator failure; stop workload, preserve evidence, no label/dataset use.
deviations.INVALID: Evidence/label/integrity/split/source mismatch, empty/partial capture, extractor/checksum/row-count failure; exclude from scientific dataset and preserve record.
deviations.PASS: All required evidence and gates pass.
deviations.PASS_WITH_DOCUMENTED_LIMITATION: Non-label-affecting limitation, preregistered and accepted before analysis; never used to waive split, identity, checksum, or ground-truth rules.

evidence_per_capture: generator logs and counts; target evidence where available

profiles.DDoS: New bounded distributed HTTP workload from the four independent generators only; F0 supplies no execution commands.
profiles.Normal: Representative bounded benign HTTP, explicitly logged, no concurrent DDoS/PortScan in its window.
profiles.PortScan: Representative approved runtime PortScan profile preserving the evidence class that remediated RF-v2; bounded, controlled, separately labeled.

split_plan.separation: No session, PCAP hash, raw CSV hash, lineage ID, capture relative, or duplicate flow identity may cross splits. Final remains sealed/unseen until candidate freeze.
split_plan.why: Three independent smaller sessions per class/split provide minimal replication and permit per-session reporting; one large capture is insufficient.

topology.independence: Each traffic generator is a separately provisioned VM and network stack; IP aliases, shared namespaces, and a single generator acting as multiple sources are invalid.
topology.isolation: Private UTM lab only; no public/corporate routes; explicit deny/verification before capture.
topology.routing: Each independent generator routes only to the controlled target via ubuntu-nids. ubuntu-nids forwards between lab subnets and captures at enp0s3; it is observer/router, not a generator.
